l0.speaker: narrator
l0.text: The council room balcony after the winter gala. Julian's tie is loosened for the first time all semester.

l1.speaker: java
l1.text: Write once, run anywhere. I only want to write this once: wherever you go, I want to be there.

l2.speaker: java
l2.text: I'm keeping the presidency, on my own terms this time. And I'd like you to be my vice president. ...And my partner.

l3.speaker: narrator
l3.text: Epilogue: two mugs, side by side, on the council desk.
